01 — A letter for you
For my Diyuu27.09

Dear Diyuu,

Happy Birthday to the person who somehow makes my world softer, brighter, and a whole lot more beautiful just by being in it.

I don't know if words can ever explain what you mean to me. But if I had to choose one thing to wish for today, it would be simple: I hope life gives you the same warmth, happiness and love that you give me without even trying.

Thank you for the laughs, the silly faces, the little moments, the hugs, and all the memories that I never want to forget. Every picture here is more than a photo — it's a tiny piece of our story.

Forever cheering for you,
Prince ❤️
